en: I love my dog.
He is a farmer.
She is very happy.
The cat is sleeping.
I am hungry.
It is very windy today.
We are teachers.
This book is mine.
Open the door.
Please wait here.
I like apples.
They live in Beijing.
My mother is a teacher.
The water is too hot.
I have two brothers.
Thank you for the gift.
Today is Monday.
The sky is blue.
He runs fast.
I don't eat meat.
What is your brother's name?
key_points: 疑问；兄弟（哥哥或弟弟均可）；名字

en: Where does your sister work?
key_points: 疑问“哪里”；工作；姐姐或妹妹均可

en: How old is your daughter?
Why is the baby crying?
Who broke the window?
Does she speak French?
What time does the store open?
I went to the museum yesterday.
She will come back tomorrow.
We have already eaten dinner.
He did not go to the party.
I have never been to Japan.
They were playing football when it started to rain.
zh_ref: 开始下雨时，他们正在踢足球。

en: She doesn't like coffee.
Can you help my brother?
key_points: 疑问；帮；兄弟（哥哥或弟弟均可）

en: Did you see that movie last week?
zh_ref: 你上周看那部电影了吗？

en: The train has just left.
I was not at home last night.
How much does this shirt cost?
Nobody knows the answer.
You should go to bed early.
You must not smoke here.
This car is more expensive than that one.
He is the tallest boy in the class.
My sister is as tall as I am.
key_points: 一样高；姐姐或妹妹均可

en: The letter was written by my father.
The window was broken by the children.
There are three cats under the table.
Most of my friends live abroad.
zh_ref: 我的大多数朋友住在国外。

en: Few people came to the meeting.
key_points: “很少”的否定义，不能译成“一些”

en: I would like a cup of tea.
It may snow tonight.
He used to smoke a lot.
I am going to visit my grandparents this weekend.
zh_ref: 这个周末我要去看望祖父母。

en: She asked me to close the window.
I want to learn how to ride a horse.
It took me three hours to finish my homework.
zh_ref: 我花了三个小时才做完作业。

en: Both of them are good at math.
Neither answer is correct.
She is too tired to walk any further.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
zh_ref: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

en: Although he was ill, he still went to work.
zh_ref: 虽然他生病了，但还是去上班了。

en: I will call you when I arrive at the airport.
zh_ref: 我到机场时会给你打电话。
key_points: 到机场；打电话；时间先后

en: The man who is standing by the door is my uncle.
zh_ref: 站在门边的那个人是我叔叔。
key_points: 定语从句；舅舅/叔叔等均可

en: This is the book that I told you about.
zh_ref: 这就是我跟你说过的那本书。

en: Because she missed the bus, she was late for class.
zh_ref: 因为她没赶上公共汽车，所以上课迟到了。

en: I think that he is telling the truth.
He said that he would never come back.
zh_ref: 他说他再也不会回来了。

en: I don't know where she went.
As soon as she heard the news, she started to cry.
zh_ref: 她一听到这个消息就哭了起来。

en: Not only does he sing well, but he also dances beautifully.
zh_ref: 他不仅歌唱得好，舞也跳得很美。
key_points: 不仅唱歌还有跳舞，两者都要有

en: If I were you, I would not accept that offer.
zh_ref: 如果我是你，我不会接受那个提议。
key_points: 虚拟；否定；接受。offer 可译提议/录用

en: She studied hard so that she could pass the exam.
zh_ref: 她努力学习，以便能通过考试。

en: The more you practice, the better you will become.
zh_ref: 你练习得越多，就会变得越好。

en: The house where I grew up has been sold.
zh_ref: 我长大的那所房子已经被卖掉了。

en: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.
zh_ref: 除非你快点，否则会赶不上火车。
key_points: 除非/否则的逻辑不能反

en: Before you leave, remember to turn off the lights.
I wish I had listened to my parents' advice.
zh_ref: 我真希望当初听了父母的建议。

en: What surprised me most was that nobody complained.
zh_ref: 最让我惊讶的是没有人抱怨。

en: Whether he comes or not, the meeting will start at nine.
zh_ref: 不管他来不来，会议都将在九点开始。

en: He let the cat out of the bag.
key_points: 习语：泄露秘密，直译猫和袋子不通过

en: Break a leg!
key_points: 习语：祝好运，直译断腿不通过

en: Practice makes perfect.
The old man kicked the bucket last year.
key_points: 习语：去世；去年。直译踢桶不通过

en: Time flies like an arrow.
She went to the bank to deposit her salary.
They sat on the bank of the river and watched the sunset.
zh_ref: 他们坐在河岸上看日落。

en: The trophy does not fit in the suitcase because it is too big.
zh_ref: 奖杯放不进手提箱，因为奖杯太大了。
key_points: 奖杯放进箱子，方向不能反；太大；“它”可接受

en: Scientists have discovered a new species of fish in the deep ocean.
zh_ref: 科学家在深海发现了一种新的鱼类。

en: The government announced on Tuesday that it would raise the minimum wage next year.
zh_ref: 政府周二宣布，明年将提高最低工资。
key_points: 周二；明年；提高最低工资

en: Climate change is one of the greatest challenges facing humanity today.
zh_ref: 气候变化是当今人类面临的最大挑战之一。
key_points: 气候变化；最大挑战之一；人类

en: Artificial intelligence is changing the way people work and communicate.
zh_ref: 人工智能正在改变人们工作和交流的方式。
key_points: 人工智能；改变；工作和交流

en: The company's profits fell by ten percent in the third quarter of 2023.
zh_ref: 该公司2023年第三季度的利润下降了百分之十。
key_points: 利润下降；百分之十；2023年第三季度

en: The flight from Shanghai to London was delayed for six hours because of heavy fog.
zh_ref: 由于大雾，从上海飞往伦敦的航班延误了六个小时。
key_points: 上海到伦敦方向；六小时；大雾

en: Dr. Smith, who has taught at the university for thirty years, will retire in June.
zh_ref: 在这所大学任教三十年的史密斯博士将于六月退休。
key_points: 史密斯；三十年；六月；退休

en: Reading not only broadens our knowledge but also helps us understand people from different cultures.
zh_ref: 阅读不仅能拓宽我们的知识，还能帮助我们理解不同文化背景的人。
key_points: 两个作用都要有；不同文化

en: Despite the heavy traffic, we managed to arrive at the station ten minutes before the train departed.
zh_ref: 尽管交通拥堵，我们还是在火车发车前十分钟赶到了车站。

en: Had it not been for your help, I could never have finished this project on time.
zh_ref: 要不是你的帮助，我绝不可能按时完成这个项目。
key_points: 要不是（实际得到了帮助）；按时完成

en: The children, tired after a long day at the beach, fell asleep as soon as they got into the car.
zh_ref: 孩子们在海滩玩了一整天，累了，一上车就睡着了。

en: Many young people leave their hometowns to look for better jobs in big cities, even though the cost of living there is much higher.
zh_ref: 许多年轻人离开家乡去大城市寻找更好的工作，尽管那里的生活成本高得多。
key_points: 离开家乡；大城市好工作；生活成本更高
